\section*{Appendix II\quad Variable Definitions}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent The cash ratio and the firm-financial controls $X_{i,t}$ are constructed from quarterly Compustat North America fundamentals as follows.
\vspace{6pt}
\begin{center}
\small
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\linewidth}
\begin{tabular}{lll}
\toprule
Variable & Definition & Interpretation \\
\midrule
CashRatio & $\mathrm{cheq}/\mathrm{atq}$ & cash and equivalents over total assets \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{3}{l}{\textit{Firm-financial controls $X_{i,t}$}} \\
Leverage & $(\mathrm{dlcq}+\mathrm{dlttq})/\mathrm{atq}$ & interest-bearing debt over assets \\
lnAssets & $\ln(\mathrm{atq})$ & firm size \\
Tobin's $Q$ & $(\mathrm{atq}+\mathrm{cshoq}\cdot\mathrm{prccq}-\mathrm{ceqq})/\mathrm{atq}$ & market-to-book \\
ROA & $\mathrm{iby}/\overline{\mathrm{assets}}$ & profitability \\
Capex & $\mathrm{capxy}/\mathrm{atq}$ & investment intensity \\
DivDummy & $\mathbf{1}[\mathrm{dvy}>0]$ & dividend payer \\
sCFO & five-year rolling standard deviation of $\mathrm{oancfy}/\mathrm{atq}_{t-1}$ & cash-flow volatility \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{3}{l}{\textit{Convergent-validity controls (Tables 5.6--5.8)}} \\
FirmMat & firm lifecycle stage from age, sales growth, and capital structure & firm maturity \\
EarnVol & rolling standard deviation of quarterly earnings over assets & earnings volatility \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{3}{l}{\textit{Cash-position indicator (Table 5.9)}} \\
HighCash & $\mathbf{1}[\mathrm{CashRatio}\ge p_{67}]$ & cash-rich (top tercile of $\mathrm{CashRatio}$) \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{3}{l}{\textit{Bid-ask extended controls (Table 5.12)}} \\
StockPrice & CRSP share price (winsorized) & price level \\
Turnover & trading volume over shares outstanding (CRSP) & share turnover \\
DailyVola & daily return volatility (CRSP) & return volatility \\
AbsSurpDec & $|\mathrm{SurpDec}|$, absolute earnings-surprise decile & surprise magnitude \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{adjustbox}
\end{center}
